title: Maneuver vector display
summary: Read-only node and predicted path overlays.

blocks.text: This optional presentation contribution draws detached maneuver snapshots, with bounded Hermite path dashes and no world commands. It retains builtin.maneuver-planner and the original v1 adapter for default controls and saves. The v2 capability is view.maneuver-display@1.0.0; a planner editor can require it while a compatible read-only viewer can supply its own validated snapshot. Removal removes overlays and authoring UI enablement, preserving live physics. Shipped identity requires the exact catalogue pin; edited forks use creator IDs.
